newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney May same-store sales up 1.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney May same-store sales up 1.7 pct.

text.p: NOTE: Figures in millions except percentage.
Month is four weeks ended May 31.
Full company name is J.C. Penney Co Inc.
Results above are for J.C. Penney stores. Total sales for the J.C. Penney Co for the four weeks ended May 31, 1997, increased 43.5 percent to $1,997 million vs $1,391 million.
For the month, total catalog sales increased 10.5 percent and sales at Eckerd drugstores increased 8.8 percent on a same-store basis, while total Eckerd sales increased 100 percent for the month.
